title: Power Apps: row summaries in model-driven apps reach GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap timing, licensing, consumption model and environment control are supported. The maker route reaches the correct configuration screen but should identify the final Show row summary toggle.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.where: summary; front matter: targetDate; What's changing
claims.claim: The roadmap targets December CY2026 rather than committing to availability then.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The planned release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.where: title; summary; front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists GCC and GCC High, and does not list DoD.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes expanding the experience already available to commercial customers to supported government environments.
claims.quote: This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments

claims.claim: The roadmap says the planned expansion meets applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.
claims.quote: while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

claims.claim: Admins and makers enable and configure the planned government row-summary experience for users.
claims.quote: Admins and makers enable and configure row summaries for users in their model-driven apps.

claims.claim: Row summaries provide an AI-generated overview of a record.
claims.quote: The Row summary feature in apps provides you with a concise, AI-generated overview of key details about a record.

claims.claim: Summaries appear in the Insights bar on main forms.
claims.quote: From the Insights bar at the top of main forms.

claims.claim: Users access a summary from a view through the inline Summary action.
claims.quote: From view pages by selecting the inline Summary action in the grid, which opens the summary for a record in a modal popup.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Makers configure a table's summary prompt to specify the columns included.
claims.quote: Write a custom prompt to specify which columns should be included in a Copilot-generated row summary.

claims.claim: Microsoft's Power Platform Copilot FAQ says Copilot adheres to existing data permissions and policies.
claims.quote: Copilot adheres to existing data permissions and policies

claims.claim: The Copilot FAQ says responses are based only on data the user personally can access.
claims.quote: its responses to you're based only on data that you personally can access.

claims.claim: Learn documents that form fill assistance does not currently support fields with column security.
claims.quote: Fields that have column security aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: The form-fill column-security limitation is not documented as a row-summary limitation.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "column security". Read record-summaries, configure-form-row-summary, faq-record-summaries and form-filling-assistance; no passage extends that form-fill limitation to row summaries.

claims.claim: The feature reads the current record's data.
claims.quote: The feature reads the data on the current record

claims.claim: The feature generates a natural-language summary.
claims.quote: generates a short, natural-language summary that highlights key information

claims.claim: Generated summaries may be wrong.
claims.quote: The response generated might be incorrect or misleading and could cause unintended outcomes from the flow or app.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn requires a Power Apps premium user licence for row summaries in a Power Apps model-driven app.
claims.quote: Power Apps model-driven app: The user must have a Power Apps premium license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn requires a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium user licence for row summaries in a Dynamics 365 model-driven app.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 model-driven app: The user must have a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license

claims.claim: The feature is hidden from users without the required licence.
claims.quote: If the user doesn't have the license, the feature is hidden.

claims.claim: Microsoft says licence enforcement rolls out gradually following general availability.
claims.quote: This license enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.

claims.claim: Usage may be subject to service limits.
claims.quote: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling. Microsoft reserves the right to update the limits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.
claims.quote: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: AI Builder features in Power Apps consume AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: In Power Apps and Power Automate, AI Builder features consume either AI Builder credits (Licensing and AI Builder credits), or Copilot Credits (Licensing and Copilot Credits).

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, combining the documented user licence with AI Builder consumption.
claims.quote: AI Builder is licensed on a capacity basis. Building custom and testing models (including prompts) doesn't require AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits. Running them in agents, agent flows, apps, or flows consume these credits.

claims.claim: Variable cost is consistent with the named AI Builder credits and Copilot Credits consumption.
claims.quote: AI Builder features in apps and flows first try to consume AI Builder credits, then if absent or exhausted, they try to consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Government terms may differ from the general offering.
claims.quote: The Power Apps US Government service description is designed to serve as an overlay to the general Power Apps service description. It defines the unique commitments of this service and the differences from Power Apps offerings

claims.claim: Government-specific pricing for row summaries is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "government" "pricing"; "AI Builder" "GCC High" "price". Read row-summary licensing, AI Builder administer-licensing and Power Apps US Government; found general rates but no government-specific row-summary price.

claims.claim: The default for the government rollout is not stated, with differing general Learn statements explicitly reported.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "GCC" "default"; "row summaries" "government" "default state". Read roadmap, user/configuration guides and FAQ; enablement and default-on statements do not specify the government rollout's default.

claims.claim: The row-summary user guide says a Power Platform administrator must enable Row summaries for the environment.
claims.quote: A Power Platform administrator must enable Row summaries for the environment in the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary.

claims.claim: The row-summary FAQ says the AI insight cards environment setting is on by default.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards environment setting that enables row summaries is on by default.

claims.claim: The FAQ says makers still need to configure and turn on summary prompts on individual tables.
claims.quote: Makers still need to configure and turn on summary prompts on individual tables so that row summaries appear on the corresponding forms and views.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The environment control is in Power Platform admin center at Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary > Row summaries > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings. Under Power Apps, locate Row summaries in the Summary section. Select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and automation paragraph
claims.claim: An equivalent automation operation for the environment row-summary control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries PowerShell API; EnableFormInsights; EnvironmentManagementSetting Update; pac admin. Read row-summary guides, Organization reference, PAC environment-management and settings PATCH reference; no operation documents the deciding setting in its request.

claims.claim: Power Apps (maker) > Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary reaches the prompt and visibility configuration screen.
claims.quote: Under Customizations, select Row summary. In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle in the upper-right corner to show or hide the summary.
claims.fix: For the visibility control, extend the path to 'Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary'. Retain the same docs URL; the Prompt box is on that configuration screen.

claims.claim: An equivalent automation call for the maker's summary prompt and visibility control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries PowerShell API; AI Skill Config Web API; aiskillconfig table/entity reference; AI Skill Config PATCH. Read configure-form-row-summary and ai-skill-config-table; no reference documents an operation and property that set this control.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: The configuration guide describes the maker configuration as applying to all main forms and views for the table.
claims.quote: When you configure the row summary, it applies to all views and main forms for the table.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: Show row summary can hide the custom summaries configured through this experience.
claims.quote: Turning off Show row summary hides the configured summary from all main forms and view pages for the table. The prompt configuration is retained so the summary can be shown again later.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: The Show row summary toggle does not hide Microsoft-provided summaries.
claims.quote: It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: Summaries configured through another application or experience need their own controls rather than this Show row summary toggle.
claims.quote: It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft or summaries configured through another application or experience, such as Customer Service summaries for custom tables.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: A separate tenant switch specific to GCC and GCC High row summaries is not documented on either surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "GCC" "switch"; "row summaries" "GCC High" "setting". Read row-summary admin/configuration guidance, Copilot hub and Power Apps US Government; found the environment control, not a government-specific tenant UI or call.

claims.claim: The documented environment control governs row summaries in model-driven apps rather than a separate government-only capability.
claims.quote: This setting controls row summaries on both model-driven app main forms and view pages.

claims.claim: The Copilot settings environment setting is the primary environment-level row-summary availability control.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot settings experience in the Power Platform admin center as the primary environment-level control for row summaries:

claims.claim: The control over who can use AI features in model-driven apps is in preview.
claims.quote: This capability is currently in preview

claims.claim: The preview user-selection control is only for environments activated for Managed Environments.
claims.quote: is only for environments activated for managed environments, with a subset of Copilot features adhering to it.

claims.claim: The preview control can explicitly allow specific users within an environment.
claims.quote: Admins can define who within an environment can use Copilot capabilities in model-driven apps either by explicitly allowing specific users

claims.claim: The preview control can allow all users except a defined exclusion list.
claims.quote: or allowing all users except a defined exclusion list.

claims.claim: The Copilot hub lists Power Apps Row summary among the features adhering to that preview control.
claims.quote:
Review the following table to learn which capabilities adhere to this configuration.
| Power Apps | Row summary |

claims.claim: The Copilot hub page does not specify whether this preview user-selection control is available in GCC or GCC High.
claims.quote: Searched: Managed Environments AI features GCC Copilot. Read copilot-hub, including its preview control section and feature table; the page gives the Managed Environments prerequisite but no GCC or GCC High availability statement for this control.

claims.claim: AI insight cards in the environment feature settings currently exposes the same row-summary control.
claims.quote: The same control is currently also available as AI insight cards in the environment feature settings.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the AI insight cards location will be removed in a future release.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards location will be removed in a future release.

claims.claim: Unlike the configuration guide's table-wide wording, the FAQ describes configuring and hiding summaries on specific forms.
claims.quote: Makers can configure which forms show a row summary, edit the default AI-generated prompt that controls what the summary emphasizes, and hide row summaries from specific forms.

claims.claim: A row-summary-specific usage report is not yet documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summary" "usage" "report"; "row summaries" "usage analytics". Read row-summary guidance, FAQ and Copilot hub's Power Apps analytics section; found data entry/exploration agent analytics, not a row-summary-specific report.

claims.claim: The summary mechanism processes record data through a generative AI service.
claims.quote: Prompt builder prompts run on Azure OpenAI Service hosted by Microsoft. Customer data isn't used to train or improve any of the Azure OpenAI Service foundation models.

controlChecks.governs: Summary prompt and whether a table shows a summary
